product_metadata.title: MAYTEX Jodie Chenille Striped Fabric Shower Curtain, 72X72
features: DESIGN: Featuring a textured chenille stripe pattern with cool tones of blue and taupe
BUTTONHOLE CONSTRUCTION: The durable buttonhole top construction allows for easy hanging with different style shower curtain hooks and rings
MEASURES: The fabric shower curtain measures 72 inches x 72 inches and fits standard size shower / bathtub areas
EASY CARE: Jodie Striped Fabric Shower Curtain is machine washable for easy care and maintenance
description: Add a touch of luxury your bathroom decor with the Jodie Chenille Stripe Fabric Shower Curtain. Featuring a textured chenille stripe pattern with cool tones of blue and taupe. The Jodie Fabric Shower Curtain is machine washable for easy care. Fits standard size bathtub/shower space up to 72 inches wide. Hooks not included. Recommend using a vinyl liner behind this curtain inside the tub.
